screens.penny: Hi, {name}! Today we'll learn what saving means.

screens.title: Spend or save?

cards.caption: Spend means you use your money now.
Save means you keep it for later.

screens.penny: Both are okay, {name}. Saving just means later.

screens.prompt: Mia puts a coin in her jar to use next month. Is she spending or saving?
screens.pennyHint: Look where the coin is going, {name}.
screens.rightMessage: Yes, {name}! The coin is waiting in the jar. That's saving.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! The coin is staying in the jar for later, so that's saving.

screens.prompt: Sam buys a snack with his coin today. Is he spending or saving?
screens.pennyHint: Is the coin staying, or going, {name}?
screens.rightMessage: That's it, {name}! He used his coin now. That's spending.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! The coin left his hand today, so that is spending.
screens.retryIntro: Let's look at the snack again, {name}.

screens.prompt: You have 5 coins. Put 3 in the jar to save them.
screens.pennyHint: Tap a coin to move it, {name}.
screens.rightMessage: Nice counting, {name}! 3 coins are saved, and 2 are left to use.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! Count them with me: 1, 2, 3 go in the jar.
screens.retryIntro: Let's count into the jar again, {name}.

screens.title: Lesson done, {name}!
screens.message: Saving means keeping some money for later.
